svg.text: A funnel opens into three parallel historical case studies of relational (workless) societies, which converge on a
single conclusion about what work actually gives us.

g.text: After Work, We'll Have Each Other
The thesis that AI will revert us to a relational, pre-industrial society is tested against three historical case
studies, all of which converge on the same finding about what work actually supplies.

g.text: Aristocratic court life, freed entirely from work, organized itself around heraldic precedence, gossip, and status
policing — a civilized but not inevitable version of primate dominance behavior.
